title: The Candle Problem
author: Mingde
excerpt: Have you made use of all the available conditions?

blocks.text: The Solution to the Candle Problem

inline.s: Have you made use of all the available conditions?

Many people will try to pin the candle to the wall with thumbtacks, which of course does not work. Others use a match to melt the edge of the candle and try to stick it to the wall — this seems like a good idea, but it does not work either. Gradually, after five or ten minutes, many people arrive at the answer.
So the key to solving this problem lies in overcoming a psychological obstacle called 'functional fixedness (
).' When you see the box, you treat it merely as a container for the thumbtacks, but it can serve other purposes too! If you use it as a platform for the candle, the problem is solved.
The lesson: have you made full use of
available conditions? Lu You wrote in his Instructions to My Son: 'If you truly wish to learn poetry, the real work lies beyond poetry itself.'
